actionDescription:
Save the current draft to a file in root of the folder associated with the bookmark named “Obsidian Vault”.

The first line of the draft will be used as the file name, with a `.md` extension.

For this to work, it is important that your Obsidian Vault be stored in a folder accessible to bookmarks. See [bookmark docs](https://docs.getdrafts.com/docs/settings/bookmarks) for additional details.

For more details and ideas, read our [Obsidian Integration Guide](https://forums.getdrafts.com/t/using-drafts-with-obsidian/11221)
name: Save in Obsidian Vault
